design_note: Organized by CLAIM and COMPARATOR ROLE, deliberately not by paper section or experiment number. Section numbers and framing have already changed repeatedly; the stable objects are the four scientific claims and what each comparator is for. The paper may call these Experiment 1, E2 or Figure 3 without rewriting scientific infrastructure.

state_independent_empirical_family_prior.formula: P_emp(y|x) proportional to sum over k with y in N_k(x) of q(k)/|N_k(x)|, normalized over families legal at x
steps: estimate a single family distribution q(k) from the REALIZED FROZEN TRAINING LAW, not raw corpus counts
at state x, remove families with no legal productive successors
renormalize q(k) over the families legal at x
within a legal family, assign mass uniformly over DISTINCT CANONICAL successors produced by that family
if the same canonical molecule is reachable through multiple families, SUM those contributions at the canonical-successor level
state_independent_empirical_family_prior.why_this_and_not_the_weaker_version: It is much stronger than 'sample a family by global frequency then pick a raw mark': it gets the correct global operator frequencies, the exact legal chemistry support, state-dependent availability for free, and alias aggregation. What it does NOT get is learned molecular-context dependence, which is exactly what makes R_theta > P_emp mean the network learned state-dependent chemistry.

uniform_canonical_successor.formula: P_unif(y|x) = 1 / |N+(x)| over distinct productive canonical successors

global_fairness_rules: Use identical source molecules, objective implementations, feasibility predicates, and final evaluators.
Count every property-oracle evaluation, including rejected candidates, particles, prescreened candidates, and reranked endpoints.
Report model calls, legal successors scored, wall time, and accelerator class separately from oracle calls.
Use the same random seeds and output sample count when the baseline interface permits it.
Never claim equal support for an external method; report representation and support differences explicitly.
Do not compare published numbers unless the task, oracle, constraints, budget, and selection rule are identical.
Tune on development tasks only and evaluate the sealed final task set once.

reporting.do_not_initially_add: ten more baselines; add untrained-architecture and local-feature MLP only as confirmatory ablations if the core result is strong
